newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-PUNTERS STILL FANCY WOODS FOR BRITISH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PUNTERS STILL FANCY WOODS FOR BRITISH OPEN.

text.p: Bookmakers were still receiving bets on Friday for Tiger Woods to win the British Open even though he was 13 shots behind the leader at the halfway stage.
But the odds on the world number one, who had started the tournament as 5-1 favourite, drifted to 40-1 after his second round three-over par 74 left him way down the field on 146.

British bookmaker William Hill said one bet of 200 pounds ($334) had been placed on Woods to win and later another punter wagered 1,000 pounds ($1,670) that he would finish in the top four. The odds were then reduced to 28-1.
Leader Darren Clarke was made 11-4 favourite to win on Sunday. Americans Justin Leonard and Fred Couples were 9-2 and Swede Jesper Parnevik 5-1.
